sections.heading: Asutosh College vs Bethune College for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Asutosh College if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹7,080, in a public BA setting at Kolkata.
Choose Bethune College if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, in a public BA setting at Kolkata.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹7,080 as a tuition figure for B.A at Asutosh College. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Bethune College that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Asutosh College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on B.A. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Bethune College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹6 LPA on Bachelor of Arts (Hons) English. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility

Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Asutosh College or Bethune College?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Asutosh College and Bethune College differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of BA classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Asutosh College vs Bethune College?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹7,080 for Asutosh College on B.A; we do not hold a quotable fee for Bethune College on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Asutosh College and Bethune College?
faqs.answer: Asutosh College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on B.A. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Asutosh College and Bethune College accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Asutosh College, and no listed exam on this page for Bethune College. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Kolkata, West Bengal. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
